title: The quest dialogs of WC-MAIN-C01-001: Merle Ambrose reminds a wizard of the quest it holds, and Mr. Lincoln's Completion lines play when the wizard talks to him, each counted with its voice lines
notes: 7.13: after the accept, walking out of Merle Ambrose's range and back lists the held quest as an UnderwayEntry; taking it plays its Underway dialog, or logs that it has none.

Talking to Mr. Lincoln plays the Completion dialog of WC-MAIN-C01-001_Goal0, his four lines WizQst1625D7 3 to 6. Every dialog the server shows is logged with its line count and how many lines carry a voice file the client plays from the install.
server_log_allowed: character_create_school holds no school, so no wizard can be created until it does
realmlist holds no realm, so no player can be sent to a gameserver until one is added

log in
the server accepts the password

the second Prep line and the offer window
